topic: Paying a five hundred dollar annual fee for card perks you never use vs a no fee cash back card (Joel vs Gwendolyn)

scenes.narration: A premium card is a bill unless you use every perk. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a shiny metal credit card with a tag reading FIVE HUNDRED A YEAR, comic burst banner reads USE IT OR PAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Joel and Gwendolyn both spend two thousand dollars a month on cards.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man joel and woman gwendolyn each holding a statement reading TWO THOUSAND MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Joel gets the heavy metal card with a five hundred dollar annual fee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man joel admiring a heavy metal card, a fee line reads FIVE HUNDRED ANNUAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Airport lounges, travel credits, and hotel perks he never uses.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a list of perks reading LOUNGE, TRAVEL CREDIT, HOTEL STATUS, each with a dusty cobweb, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He flies once a year and forgets to use the credits.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man joel at an airport gate walking past a lounge door, a credit reading UNUSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Points earned, worth about three hundred. Fee paid, five hundred.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading POINTS THREE HUNDRED, FEE FIVE HUNDRED, NET MINUS TWO HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gwendolyn picks a no fee card paying two percent cash back on everything.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gwendolyn holding a plain card with a badge reading NO FEE TWO PERCENT BACK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two percent on twenty four thousand a year is four hundred eighty dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a gym whiteboard reading TWO PERCENT OF TWENTY FOUR THOUSAND EQUALS FOUR EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cash back lands in her savings account automatically every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an automatic deposit labeled CASH BACK flowing into a savings jar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays the balance in full, so interest never touches her.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gwendolyn tapping PAY IN FULL, a statement reading INTEREST ZERO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Joel lost two hundred on his fancy card. Gwendolyn gained four eighty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man joel beside a fee bill, woman gwendolyn beside a cash back total reading FOUR EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Skipped perks are just fees. Pick the card that pays you. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading PICK THE CARD THAT PAYS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
